title: Intro Angle Picks
eyebrow: GPOM second half · scene A · picks · round 3
heading: The overhead shot, with the rubble back
intro: Your round 12 note: the road in the overhead shot is far too tidy compared with the other shots. My last edit cleared the road along with the parking bays. Four stills, no video credit spent. 8a and 8b go back to your original 5b and only remove the bay lines and the grain, so its rubble stays. 9a and 9b take 7a and pile rubble, potholes and weeds back onto the road. Pick one; I then animate it slowly, as in round 12, for both overhead moments.

sections.lede: The overhead moments are at 0:35 and 1:10.
